elements.name: lt-field
elements.description: Wires label, field, help text and error text together: sets `aria-describedby` and `aria-invalid` on the control and an id on the help text and the error text. Never writes an id on the control: the template writes `for` and `id`, or wraps the field in the label. The field is invalid when the error text is there without `hidden`. Exists for markup produced without JavaScript. When the markup is produced with JavaScript, use `lt.field()` instead.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: The control is disabled.

attributes.name: optional
attributes.description: The field is optional, and the label says so.

attributes.name: described-by
attributes.description: Extra ids to include in `aria-describedby`, separated by spaces.

elements.name: lt-tabs
elements.description: Tab list. The tabs are links to the panels in an `.lt-tabs__list`, so without JavaScript the list is a table of contents; `role="tab"` on anything other than a link is not a tab. The component adds keyboard and focus handling, sets roles and wiring, gives each panel its tab's name, makes only the selected panel a tab stop, and hides the rest with `hidden="until-found"`, so find in page and links into a panel reach them. Each selection is written to the URL. It never writes an id on a tab or a panel. When the page loads, the selected tab is the one with `aria-selected` from the server, otherwise the one the URL points to, otherwise the first one not hidden with `hidden`. Under `server-controlled` the URL never selects.

attributes.name: server-controlled
attributes.description: The server decides which tab is selected. The component does not put the user's selection back after an update from the server, and the URL selects no tab. A click and find in page select the tab until the server responds.

attributes.name: activation
attributes.description: What the arrow keys do. By default they select the tab at once.

values.name: manual
values.description: The arrow keys only move focus, and Enter or Space selects. For when a panel's content takes time to load.

values.name: automatic
values.description: The arrow keys select the tab, the same as without the attribute.

events.name: tab-select
events.description:
The user selected a tab. `index` counts from 0.

`detail`: `{ index: number }`

elements.name: lt-error-summary
elements.description: Error summary. Moves focus to the box when it appears, and to the control when a link in the list is followed.

attributes.name: data-autofocus
attributes.description: Whether focus moves to the box when it appears. On by default.

values.name: true
values.description: Move focus, the same as without the attribute. Anything other than "false" moves focus.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.description: The box is hidden. The server removes the attribute when the form fails, and the component then moves focus.

elements.name: lt-popover
elements.description: A panel that hangs from a button and closes itself. A button and a panel with the class `lt-popover` and an id from the template; the component sets `popover` and `aria-controls` where the markup came without them, but never the id.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: The panel is open. The server can send the attribute to open the panel.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Which edge of the button the panel hangs from.

values.name: bottom-start
values.description: Below the button, along the start edge. The default.

values.name: bottom-end
values.description: Below the button, along the end edge.

values.name: top-start
values.description: Above the button, along the start edge.

values.name: top-end
values.description: Above the button, along the end edge.

attributes.name: server-controlled
attributes.description: The server decides whether the panel is open. The component does not put `open` back when an update from the server removes it.

events.name: popover-toggle
events.description:
The user opened or closed the panel, or `show()`, `hide()` or `toggle()` was called. Setting `open` as a property or attribute dispatches no event.

`detail`: `{ open: boolean }`

elements.name: lt-suggestion
elements.description: Field with a suggestion list. A `<label for>`, an `<input id>`, an `.lt-suggestion__list` with `<li>` items and a `[role=status]` are enough; the component sets the roles and the wiring where the markup came without them, and gives the list and the options ids. The field never gets an id from the component. Filters as the user types, moves the highlight with the arrow keys and announces the number of matches.

attributes.name: prefiltered
attributes.description: The app has already filtered the list, so the component leaves it as it is. Needed when the app's filter is something other than "the text contains the search term".

attributes.name: count-none
attributes.description: The announcement for no matches. The default is "No matches".

attributes.name: count-zero
attributes.description: The announcement in the plural form `zero`, for languages that have it. `{n}` is the number.

attributes.name: count-one
attributes.description: The announcement for one match. `{n}` is the number.

attributes.name: count-two
attributes.description: The announcement in the plural form `two`, for languages that have it. `{n}` is the number.

attributes.name: count-few
attributes.description: The announcement in the plural form `few`, for languages that have it. `{n}` is the number.

attributes.name: count-many
attributes.description: The announcement in the plural form `many`, for languages that have it. `{n}` is the number.

attributes.name: count-other
attributes.description: The announcement for every other count, and the fallback when a form is missing. `{n}` is the number.

attributes.name: server-controlled
attributes.description: The server decides whether the list is expanded and which option is highlighted. The component does not put them back after an update from the server.

events.name: suggestion-select
events.description:
The user chose a suggestion. `label` is the text, `value` the code from `data-value`, or the text when the option has none. The field also gets `input` and `change`, as if the user had typed it.

`detail`: `{ value: string, label: string }`

elements.name: lt-dialog
elements.description: Makes a `<dialog class="lt-dialog">` modal with `showModal()`, for servers that cannot call it themselves. The host around the dialog. Gives the dialog its name from the first heading outside `lt-dialog__body` when neither `aria-labelledby` nor `aria-label` is there.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: The dialog is open. For the server to show it, `open` must be on `<dialog>` too.

attributes.name: server-controlled
attributes.description: When an update from the server removes `open` from `<dialog>` while the dialog is open, the component closes it and dispatches `dialog-toggle`, instead of putting `open` back.

events.name: dialog-toggle
events.description:
The dialog opened or closed. `returnValue` is the value of the button that closed it, or an empty string.

`detail`: `{ open: boolean, returnValue: string }`

elements.name: lt-toast
elements.description: A queue of short messages in the corner of the screen. The messages are created from script with `show(text, { color, duration })`.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Milliseconds before a message disappears. The default is 6000, and 0 keeps the messages.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Text that tells screen readers what the region is for.

attributes.name: close-label
attributes.description: What the close button in each message is called for screen readers. The default is "Close message".

events.name: toast-dismiss
events.description: A message was closed, by the user, because its time ran out, or with `dismiss()`. `clear()` dispatches none.

elements.name: lt-session-timeout
elements.description: Warns before a signed-in session expires, and counts down. The renderer writes the dialog and the text inside the element: a `<dialog>` with `.lt-session-timeout__count` for the number, `[role=status]` for the announcement and the buttons in a `<form method="dialog">`. Dispatches `session-warn` when the dialog opens, `session-extend` when the user wants to continue, `session-logout` when the user logs out, `session-expired` when time is up, and `session-activity` at most once per `activity-interval` while the user is active, so the app can keep the server session alive.

attributes.name: warn-at
attributes.description: Seconds without activity before the warning appears.

attributes.name: expires-at
attributes.description: Seconds without activity before the session expires.

attributes.name: activity-interval
attributes.description: Seconds between each `session-activity` while the user is active. Default 60.

events.name: session-extend
events.description: The session continues: the user closed the warning with a button other than log out or with Escape, or the app called `extend()`.

events.name: session-logout
events.description: The user chose to log out.

events.name: session-activity
events.description: The user is active. Dispatched at most once per `activity-interval`, so the app can keep the server session alive.

elements.name: lt-connection-status
elements.description: Tells the user when the connection to the server is lost. The app reports with `reportFailure()` and `reportSuccess()`.

attributes.name: offline-text
attributes.description: The text when the connection is lost.

attributes.name: online-text
attributes.description: The text when it comes back.
